title: display's legacy styles
features:
a personal script of mine that was meant to recreate the old karate punching animation style for brawler and rush

brawler fully uses uhh old animation

rush comes with a few personal touches, so don't complain about the old r2f accuracy.

comes with derek style (i think) for beast and personal touches like uhh iframes for double finishers, gurustumble, floss dragontaunt, and uhh sound changes but there could be more that i forgot.

part of the 'scripts that wasn't meant for public use but since i don't play r2f anymore, im sharing it with the community' collection of mine
